- **`bob login <agent> [provider]` starts pi for provider sign-in without the operator knowing pi's config directory (bob#241).** The operator no longer runs pi by hand with `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR`: bob reuses the session's own composer for that path and starts pi's TUI in the agent's own directory (its config directory set), so pi writes the credential to the agent's own `.pi-agent/auth.json` — the store path bob composes for every session. pi's login is an interactive slash command (`/login`) — pi ships no login subcommand or flag — so bob tells the operator which command to type; bob does NOT pass it as an argument (pi would send it to the model). It refuses an unknown agent, naming the agents directory it looked in, a non-interactive stdin/stdout (saying to run it in a terminal), and a pi executable it cannot find at the package path (naming every location searched — never a `pi` on PATH). `bob logout <agent>` starts pi so the operator can run pi's `/logout` — an interactive selector over ANY stored credential, not bound to login's target, so logout takes no provider argument (and login refuses extra positionals). The child's environment is an allowlist plus `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` for this agent only. bob READS the agent's store locally to decide the result (it parses auth.json) and never prints a credential VALUE: `bob login` reports success only when the provider it targeted now holds a credential that passes bob's local credential checks and is new or changed, never on pi's exit code alone, and an abnormal pi exit is a failure. `bob doctor <agent>` gains a check scoped to a set of providers (`openai-codex`, `github-copilot`, `xai`, `kimi-coding`): while bob.yaml names one of them and the agent's store holds no credential that passes bob's local credential checks for it — a keyless entry, an unresolved `$VAR` reference, or a placeholder does not count — doctor fails with the remedy `bob login <agent> <provider>`; a store that cannot be read or fails bob's conservative validation, or a bob.yaml that cannot be read or whose provider block cannot be parsed, also fails. This set is the check's scope, not a limit on `bob login`; anthropic is outside it, so doctor requires no login credential for anthropic. (`src/shell/login.ts`, `test/shell/login.test.ts`)
